Legends twisted through generational tale-telling and spread from hab level to spire, versus what measures the Inquisition has taken to spin worse truths in digestible lies, aiming to bolster their authority. But more often than not, an acolyte will stride into a world that is foreign to their presence, where no citizen has been before.
